name: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd.
business_summary: India's second-largest listed jeweller by revenue (TTM ~Rs39,063cr): 500+ Kalyan showrooms (franchise-owned/company-owned), Middle East stores (~11% of revenue), Candere online/omnichannel studded brand (+64% in Q2 FY27), and Muhurat. EBITDA margin ~6-7% (gold-heavy, hedged). Q2 FY27: revenue +26%, India SSSG ~20% (from ~28% in Q1). Promoter holding 62.9%. Stock +34% in 6 months and +55% in 3 months to early Oct on share-gain narrative, then flat.

exposures.mechanism: Jewellery ~100% of revenue, EBITDA margin ~6.7% TTM (Rs2,616cr on Rs39,063cr). +10% volume => revenue +10% at ~10% incremental margin vs 6.7% average => EBITDA +15% x EV/MCap 1.1 x persistence 0.45 => ~+7. Q1 FY27 SSSG 28% and Q2 20% show the cycle; pack revenue Jun 2026 Rs10,589cr.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 update: consolidated revenue +26%, India +27% with SSSG ~20% (Q1 ~28%), international +18% (~11% of revenue), Candere +64%

exposures.mechanism: Franchise-heavy (FOCO) model; gold hedged via metal loans, but revenue is price-driven (+8% gold => +5% revenue after volume dip) and inventory gains lift margin transiently while volume elasticity cuts footfalls. Net ambiguous; stock +34% in 6m while gold -12% in 6m. Gold -8.4% since June, +3.4% 12m.
